svg.title: Technology toolkit: five rows of floating icons
svg.desc: Languages: Python, C++, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript. Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Pinecone, Redis, Firebase. Ml & Ai: PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, spaCy, OpenCV. Agents & Llms: LangChain, Claude, Ollama, Hugging Face, Codex. Tools: Git, Jupyter, Anaconda, VS Code, CUDA.
